Job Title: Production Engineer 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 CACI's Ascent Vision Technologies (AVT) team in Belgrade, MT, is seeking a Production Engineer to join their organization. As part of CACI's Spectrum Superiority Line of Business, AVT manufactures best-in-class gyro-stabilized Gimbal systems designed for a wide variety of applications. Our pioneering systems support airborne, ground, and maritime missions around the world. We specialize in fully integrated solutions for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and counter drone operations for the defense and aerospace industry. 
 
 As a Production Engineer, you will support the successful introduction, production, and continuous improvement of the EO/IR imaging systems product lines. This role will focus on developing robust manufacturing processes, improving quality and efficiency, supporting test strategy and implementation, and driving operational excellence on the production floor. This position requires strong technical problem-solving skills, cross-functional collaboration, and a hands-on approach to solving complex manufacturing challenges. 


 Responsibilities: 
 Partner with Design Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Product Management teams to support new product introduction (NPI) and product manufacturing.
 Support process improvements and equipment upgrades to increase production efficiency and consistency.
 Track and report key performance indicators such as first pass yield, cycle time, uptime, and overall equipment effectiveness.
 Develop, implement, and maintain manufacturing work instructions.
 Conduct root cause analysis and develop corrective/preventive actions for manufacturing and test-related issues.
 Support continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies.
 Identify and implement process improvements that increase throughput, reduce cost, improve yield, and enhance product quality.
 Ensure compliance with ESD ANSI 20.20 and internal QMS standards.
 Collaborate with Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams to align designs with production capability and product forecasts.
 Participate in ECO/ECR processes and Material Review Boards to support engineering changes and continuous improvement.
 Design, build, and implement production tooling and fixtures as needed.
 Provide hands-on support for prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting electro‑optical assemblies.
 
 


 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
 Proficiency in ERP, PLM, and MES systems (Infor preferred).
 Experience in CAD modeling for production tooling and fixturing.
 Hands-on experience with prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting electro‑optical assemblies.
 Knowledge of BOM management, revision control, and documentation best practices.
 Familiarity with ECR/ECO processes and cross-functional collaboration in a production environment.
 Ability to identify and implement manufacturing process improvements.
 Excellent communication, organization, and analytical skills.
 
 

 Desired: 
 5+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, specifically manufacturing or production engineering.
 Advanced proficiency in Infor ERP systems.
 Certifications in Lean and Six Sigma.
 Experience working in optics/photonics or electro‑optical assemblies.
 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$60,100 - $123,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
